name: moduleKit
description: Addon-scoped module lifecycle and dependency graphs for MoltenCodes addons, with dependency injection as an optional part.
summary: Addon-scoped module lifecycle, dependency graphs and dependency policies; injection, implements contracts and required addons as optional parts.

Injection.description: Dependency injection: the four provider kinds, Resolve, Inject and the inject definition field.

Implements.description: implements contracts on module definitions and provider options, as method lists or SchemaKit schemas.

RequiredAddons.description: The requiresAddons definition field: modules taken down when another addon they need halts.
